title: weak_ptr observer pattern
prompt: Complete `Event`: `void subscribe(std::weak_ptr<void> w)` stores the watcher, and `int fire()` counts watchers whose object is still alive, pruning expired ones from the list. This is the classic observer pattern that does NOT keep observers alive.

tests.name: live-watcher
tests.hint: A live owner means one surviving watcher.

tests.name: expired-watcher
tests.hint: When the owner dies inside the scope, fire() must not count it.

tests.name: mixed-and-prune
tests.hint: fire() twice: pruning happens on the first pass, the second stays correct.
